summary: Enhance your knowledge with our comprehensive training course on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Gender-Based Violence. Empower yourself and others today.
lede: Reproductive health and gender-based violence work focuses on rights, safety and respectful support. For health, social support, protection and programme professionals, this course addresses responding to disclosures and improving services for people at risk. It covers first-line support, informed consent and confidentiality, safety planning, case management, referrals and community prevention.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with, design for, or make decisions affecting people at risk of SRH violations and GBV.
audience: Health care providers and SRH clinic staff
Social workers, case managers, and psychosocial support
Programme and project officers in NGOs
Staff in women’s rights, child protection
Police, justice, and legal aid actors
Community leaders, outreach workers, and peer educators
modules: Foundations of Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR)
Clinical and Health Sector Response to GBV
Prevention, Community Engagement, and Social Norms Change
Working With Adolescents and Young People
Coordination, Referral Pathways, and Information Management
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of health, social services, or legal frameworks related to GBV and SRH. Prior experience in related fields is beneficial but not mandatory.
